sentences.text:
Also heard the Learned Assistant Government  Pleader for Land Acquisition, who placed a copy of  the written instructions dated 8.9.2023 received from  the 6th respondent for perusal of this Court, wherein it is inter alia stated as follows:-
"In this connection, it is submitted that the Executive Engineer, SSLC & SB Sub-Division No.4, Gudur vide letter No.DB/JTO/43HM, dt:05.11.2014 and 27.11.2014 has filed requisition for acquisition of land to an extent of Acs.96.12 cents in Sy.No.1277 etc., Ponguru Village of Marripadu Mandal, SPSR Nellore District which includes petitioners land for formation of Balancing Reservoir-II and excavation of Link Canal from KM 0.002 to KM 1.085 of Anam Sanjeeva Reddy Somasila High Level Lift Canal.
Accordingly, the then Special Deputy Collector (L.A), TGP., Nellore Unit has addressed letter vide Rc.E.60/2013 dt:04.09.2018 to the Tahsildar, Marripadu directed to submit the Genuineness Certificate for the above lands to take further action.
There upon the Tahsildar, Marripadu has not submitted Genuineness Certificate along with 1B & Adangal copies of the petitioner land as DKT land.
Hence we are not able to process the Land Acquisition process as per new L.A Act, 2013 and payment of compensation was not initiated.

Soon after receipt of the Genuineness Certificate and 1B & Adangal copies obtained from the Tahsildar, Marripadu, the appropriate action will be inclined for payment of compensation to the above said land to an extent of Acs.4.21 cents in Sy.No.1282/2 & 1283-3 as per Land Acquisition process."

sentences.text: In the light of the above stated position, it appears that the 5th respondent has not submitted the Genuineness Certificates in respect of the subject matter land.
Let appropriate instructions be obtained by the Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition from the respondent Nos.3 to 5 by the date of next adjournment.
List this case on 25.9.2023 in the Motion List.
